name: Sun Cleric: Ancient Rites already grants bonus mana from Intellect and periodic mana regen (#1825)
contract: Both ranks' effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (aura 227, natively implemented in AuraEffect::PeriodicTick / HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellWithValueAuraTick, which casts EffectTriggerSpell 301368 every EffectAmplitude 15000ms carrying the aura's own GetAmount() as SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0): rank 1's BasePoints 3 resolves to 4, rank 2's 5 resolves to 6, matching 'regenerate mana equal to 4%/6% of your maximum mana every 15 sec'. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_MAX_MANA_FROM_STAT (aura 328, natively implemented in AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModMaxManaFromStat, which requires MiscValue == POWER_MANA (0, present here as an omitted/zero field) and reads the source stat from MiscValueB): MiscValueB 3 selects STAT_INTELLECT; rank 1's BasePoints 299 resolves to 300, rank 2's 449 resolves to 450, matching 'Increases your mana by 300%/450% of your Intellect'. Both aura types are fully implemented by the core engine with no module code anywhere in this repository; the pending, unrelated sun-cleric-completion package's spell_script_names row for these two ids (not yet applied) is not required for either effect to work. Native only, no server code needed.

steps.label: Rank 1: +300% Intellect mana, 4% mana every 15 sec
Max mana rises meaningfully from the Intellect-based bonus
Rank 2 replaces rank 1: +450% Intellect mana, 6% mana every 15 sec
Max mana rises further from the larger Intellect-based bonus
